Card Q&A.q: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, can I activate both the "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers" effect and the "1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until the end of their turn" effect when activating this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. If you have 3 or fewer, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon suspends, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as it.
